title: Event history analysis with time-dependent covariates via landmarking supermodels and boosted trees
summary: We propose a nonparametric method for dynamic prediction in event history analysis with high-dimensional, time-dependent covariates. The approach estimates future conditional hazards by combining landmarking supermodels with gradient boosted trees. Unlike joint modeling or Cox landmarking models, the proposed estimator flexibly captures interactions and nonlinear effects without imposing restrictive parametric assumptions or requiring the covariate process to be Markovian.
